title: Mo Yuan (莫渊) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Mo Yuan (莫渊) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Mo Yuan (莫渊) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Mo Yuan (莫渊) is an optional encounter in Mirage Estate.

sections.title: Where to Find the Mo Yuan (莫渊)
sections.content: Location: Mirage Estate - the region itself rather than a point inside it.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Mo Yuan (莫渊)
sections.content:
What works

  • Optional, and tied to Soul Tempering materials rather than a weapon - worth doing before the final stretch.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 54 of 60 in the progression order, in Mirage Estate. Before it: Qiu Feng, the Crimson Boneblade (赤骨刀 邱风). After it: Leng Tu. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
